Relative Strength Index (RSI) is a momentum indicator that measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overbought or oversold conditions in an asset. It is calculated using a formula that takes into account the average gain and loss over a specified period of time. In this case, the RSI is calculated using a period of 14 days. A value of 70 or above indicates that the stock is overbought and a value of 30 or below indicates that the stock is oversold. 
The current RSI value is 35.56, which indicates that the stock is neither overbought nor oversold.  
Moving Averages (MA) is a technical analysis tool that helps to smooth out price data by creating a constantly updated average price. It is calculated by taking the average of a specified number of past prices. In this case, the Moving Average is calculated using a period of 10 days.  
The current Moving Average value is 2504.22, which is below the current price of 2507.36. This indicates that the stock is currently trading above its Moving Average, which is a bullish sign. 
Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) is a trend-following momentum indicator that shows the relationship between two moving averages of a security's price. It is calculated by subtracting the 26-day exponential moving average (EMA) from the 12-day EMA. A positive MACD value indicates that the 12-day EMA is above the 26-day EMA, which is a bullish sign. A negative MACD value indicates that the 12-day EMA is below the 26-day EMA, which is a bearish sign. The MACD also has a signal line, which is a 9-day EMA of the MACD.  
The current MACD value is -0.11, which is a bullish sign. The signal line is currently at -0.02, which is also a bullish sign.  
Bollinger Bands (BB) is a volatility indicator that helps to identify potential overbought or oversold conditions. It is calculated by plotting two lines above and below a moving average. The upper Bollinger Band is calculated by adding two standard deviations to the moving average, and the lower Bollinger Band is calculated by subtracting two standard deviations from the moving average. When the price of a security is above the upper Bollinger Band, it is considered to be overbought. When the price of a security is below the lower Bollinger Band, it is considered to be oversold. The current price of 2507.36 is within the Bollinger Bands, which indicates that the stock is not currently overbought or oversold. 
Fibonacci Retracement is a technical analysis tool that is used to identify potential areas of support and resistance. It is calculated by taking the difference between the high and low prices of a security over a specified period of time and then dividing that difference into Fibonacci ratios. The most common Fibonacci ratios are 23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8%, and 78.6%.

The current price of 2507.36 is above all of the Fibonacci Retracement levels, which indicates that the stock is currently in a bullish trend.
